user.title: Ready Home
user.description: Track emergency supplies and measure readiness. Name this profile (default Ready Home). Generic names appear as Ready Home in the UI; other names become a suffix, e.g. Ready Home (Cabin). The profile also sets the entity id prefix.

lists.description: Categories label items. Food and water category lists decide which categories count toward readiness. A category cannot be both food and water.

data_description.food_categories: Items in these categories count toward food readiness (calories).
